thread:
leah: Heads-up: after last night's NAT gateway rotation in us-west2b we're seeing ~20 stuck GPU slots across the warmpool. Pods re-create but never schedule because scheduler thinks slots are held.

infra-bot: Alert: gpu-slot-leak detected warmpool-usw2b (20 stuck) :warning:

peter: Symptoms: Pending pods with 'no free gpu-slot' while node shows GPU free in `nvidia-smi`. kubelet logs show lease lost+restore. Suspect TCP conn reset to node-agent during NAT IP swap.

leah: node-agent log snippet:
```
W 2026-03-22T22:40:11Z node-agent: reconnect: dial tcp x.x.x.x:443: i/o timeout
I 2026-03-22T22:40:13Z node-agent: restored connection, but kvcache: lease delta mismatch
gpu-plugin: allocated_slots=1, reported_by_kernel=0
```

eng-scheduler: Note: our gang admission controller marks the gang as RESERVED until all slots report active pod UIDs. If KV cache never clears old UID, remaining gang members are stuck in Pending.

sre-oncall: Quick manual fix that worked on two nodes:
1) ssh node -> systemctl restart node-agent
2) kubectl delete pod <stuck-pod> --namespace ml-training (triggers new allocation)
But this is disruptive.

peter: Minimal operator command to clear slot references without restart:
```
curl -sX POST http://localhost:5000/internal/reclaim?force=true
# or
kubectl annotate node N gpu-slot-status=clear
```

leah: Proposed mitigation: deploy a reconcile loop in control-plane that scans for "allocated_slots without owning Pod" and issues reclaim after 45s. Also add NAT rotation hooks to signal nodes (so agent can proactively GC).

eng-scheduler: If we auto-reclaim too aggressively we could break live migrations. Suggest two-stage: mark suspicious slots as 'stale' (metric: gpu.slot_stale_count) and only reclaim after 45s + absent kubelet heartbeat. Emit event and annotate node.

sre-oncall: Cost/ops note: shortening warmnode reservation TTL from 30m -> 12m reduces impact window but will bump cold-starts ~9% by our estimate. Need PO approval.

leah: Short-term plan: 1) roll a small canary in us-west2b with reconcile loop + NAT-signal handler (limited to warmpool nodes); 2) add datadog alerts: gpu.slot_leaks>5 and scheduler.blocked_gangs>3; 3) runbook snippets for oncall.

peter: I'll open INFRA-4370 with rollback plan and add the exact metrics and dashboards. Canaries scheduled 03:30-04:30 UTC.

eng-scheduler: Also adding a metric `scheduler.allocated_slots_without_pod` and a Grafana panel to correlate with NAT rotations.

sre-oncall: Remediation command for runbook (copyable):
```
# quick clear on node
kubectl annotate node N gpu-slot-gc=true && 
kubectl run --rm -n kube-system gc-job --image=infra/tools:latest --restart=Never -- /bin/sh -c "curl -sS http://$NODE_IP:5000/internal/reclaim?force=true"
```

leah: Great. Tracking in ticket and will follow up with PR for reconcile loop tomorrow. :thumbsup:
